summary: --- name: requesting-code-review description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements --- # Requesting Code Review Dispatch a code reviewer subagent to catch issues before they cascade. The reviewer gets precisely crafted context for evaluation — never your session's history. This keeps the reviewer focused on the work product, not your thought process, and preserves your own context for continued work. **Core principle:** Review early, review often. ## When to Request Review **Mandatory:** - After each task in subagent-driven development
